doc.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998

title: Photos: Maynard, Buddy Rich, Kennedy Center and Goodman
summary: Pictures of Maynard Ferguson at Birdland and Newport, Buddy Rich's band and the Kennedy Center opening, and Benny Goodman with Bucky Pizzarelli.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I have a clip on because there’s a couple of things in there, see?
Maynard’s still out there playing too?
He came to my home town, see I have a clip. That was Birdland.
Right. This is the Newport festival I think, this one up here. And that was Birdland.
My. How did you fit that band in there?
Well it’s the same with the Vanguard. How do you fit a band in there? It’s unbelievable.
Now here’s Buddy Rich. I’m finally pulling these out. That’s when we did, I did—

Yeah I’m playing lead alto. Well this here, the Buddy Rich, this is New Orleans. That was a quintet. Woody Dennis, John Bunch, Nobby Tota on bass. This here I’m playing lead alto with the big band for about ten days. And then we did the opening of the Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts, and I was featured with Bill Watrous, both of us, with the Buddy Rich band and so on. We did the grand opening there. I just pulled out a few choice things for you see? And here’s the Benny Goodman thing with Bucky Pizzarelli and myself. And then King Manufacturers who I endorsed for put out that there. Bucky’s still out there playing.
